Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1741207 (Sentrin-specific protease 8). Join target_dictionary, assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1741207, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
